Description of the accident (claimant's words)
I was driving our car through the intersection in Houston on 30 Jun 2024, intending to turn left onto the cross street. I
had the green light and was moving slowly through the turn when a vehicle coming from the opposite direction struck
the front passenger side of my car. The impact pushed us sideways and the airbags deployed. There were several
people in my car at the time, and everyone in it was hurt. Some of us felt neck and back pain right away, and others
had cuts and bruising from the airbags and the seatbelts. We stayed where we were until the emergency crew arrived
and checked each person on scene. I am filing this claim so the medical costs and vehicle damage for everyone in
the car can be reviewed.

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
